name: hf_trainer_finetune
title: HuggingFace Trainer fine-tune with a hand-rolled scoring pass
origin: re-created from the Sprint-2 audit's HF Trainer probe (ROADMAP b.1)

expected.defect: the TF-IDF vocabulary is fitted on every row, six lines before the split
expected.why: test-half tokens shape the vocabulary and the idf weights, so the held-out score is optimistic

expected.defect: the numeric scaler is fitted on the whole frame before train_test_split
expected.why: test-half means and variances leak into the training features
the reported metric is not reproducible across runs
shuffling an evaluation pass costs nothing but makes per-batch logs unorderable and any index-aligned analysis wrong

expected.defect: the hand-rolled scoring pass never calls model.eval()
expected.why: DistilBERT keeps dropout active and its layer norms in training mode, so the accuracy printed is not the model's

expected.defect: the scoring loop is not wrapped in torch.no_grad()
expected.why: the autograd graph is retained for every batch of the test set

expected.defect: the model is moved to the device but the batch never is
expected.why: a CPU tensor fed to a CUDA module raises at run time

expected.defect: nothing seeds transformers, torch or numpy
expected.why: neither the split nor the fine-tune can be repeated

forbidden.why: accuracy_score and f1_score are both given logits.argmax(axis=-1), which is exactly the class prediction they want
roc_auc_score is given the softmax probability column, not predict() output
the Trainer is given eval_dataset=encoded["test"], compute_metrics and eval_strategy="epoch"
the HuggingFace Trainer owns the optimisation loop; there is no hand-written update to zero gradients before
same - backward() and step() live inside Trainer.train(), not in this file
there is no hand-written backward/step pair here whose order could be wrong
no backward() call appears anywhere in this project, let alone inside no_grad()
no nn.Module subclass is defined in this project - the model comes from from_pretrained
no submodule container is built here at all
